title: Want to make a point? Remember Slotbound and Big Walk are both up for Steam Award nominations.
author: caesium23
selftext:
For those not familiar, the Steam Award nominations are currently up for voting. You can technically vote to nominate any eligible game you want, but each category presents voters with a short list of popular games to choose from, and if you know anything about human behavior, you know those are the only ones likely to win -- getting a write-in candidate across the finish line would probably take a large, organized effort. 

The good news is, Big Walk (who famously were recently denied an award because of AI even though they barely used it) and Slotbound (currently the closest AI-first game dev has come to an indie darling) are **both listed**, so we don't even need to put together a write-in campaign.

If we want to show the gaming community that AI game dev is a valid and viable path, making sure some games publicly associated with AI win Steam Awards could be a significant step in the right direction. Even just getting them nominated will force more discussion and awareness of what AI game dev is capable of.

**Big Walk** is listed for a bunch of categories, including *Defies Description* and *Better With Friends*, while **Slotbound** is only up for *Best Handheld Game*. I've voted to nominate them in every category that lists them, and I hope you'll all join me.

# [Vote to nominate Big Walk & Slotbound for Steam Awards](https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/2026/⁠)

comments.body: Big walk which literally said sorry for using ai and we will never use ai again. Slotbound is a better choice by far

comments.author: senjouara
comments.body:
I think people should vote for good games not slop, if you enjoy these games then vote for em.  
  
Them winning will not contribute to AI being seen in a positive light, twitter and reddit will be outraged, Geoff will put any AI entries on a ban list to promote real creators, blabla, etc. it will just create a new wave of AI hate.

replies.author: caesium23
replies.body: I know it seems counterintuitive, but the history of social progress shows every wave of hate is just another small step toward widespread acceptance. You have to remember that for every angry screech fighting change, at least a hundred more said nothing but quietly thought to themselves, "Hey, that's pretty cool."

comments.author: ChirpXel
comments.body: If you want to vote for the sake of helping AI games get a better rep. Slotbound by far is the best choice
